text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Wildlife trade is quantified in terms of whole organism equivalents (WOE). For example, five skulls represent
five WOEs, whereas it's assumed that four ears are sourced from two animals and so represent two WOEs.
